scope: Read-only mechanical integrity of the original 108 training-only US Piper outputs; no model scoring, playback, recording or device I/O.
checks: Authenticate the original four metadata files before reading waveforms; authenticate every declared source/output artifact.
Require the complete original ordered grid and every training-only role; reject duplicates, unsafe paths and omitted files.
Check recorded phones against config symbols and reconstruct token IDs/scales; do not claim independent phonemizer or pronunciation verification.
Preserve all original native/16k floats; recompute complete resampling with pinned packages and require exact array equality for process agreement.
Decode original PCM with Python wave; check complete mono PCM16 16k geometry and raw PCM hashes independently of soundfile decoding.
Repeat the pinned soundfile PCM conversion in memory and compare raw serialized samples; explicitly record libsndfile version and shared-converter limitation.
Independently check finite/nonzero arrays, .2..5s duration, RMS>=.001, no native/resampled full-scale values or PCM endpoints, complete lengths and generation-end reference.
mismatch_policy: Retain originals and report all numerical resampling/PCM differences. No repair, normalization, re-generation, filtering, tolerance-based pass or retries. Missing authenticated inputs stop the audit.
limits: Mechanical process agreement only. Cross-platform discrepancies do not by themselves establish corrupt audio. No physical-speaker/pretraining independence, phonetic truth, historical corpus repair, quality acceptance, model fitting/promotion or access to new development/final sets.
